verdict.line: You lose if you stand in his Dark Procession wall while Mist Walkers and Mourning Mist chip you down; you win if you survive to a completed Warmog's/Heartsteel core and strip his Maiden before every extended fight.

brief.thesis: Yorick's whole early plan is attrition — Shepherd of Souls walkers plus E (Mourning Mist) marking and slowing you while W (Dark Procession) walls you into the swarm — and that's exactly where he holds the lane and solo-kill edge (48.9% Mundo win rate over 135 games). Mundo's counter is that Q (Infected Cleaver) scales off the victim's max health, so the bigger Yorick's HP pool gets, the harder your poke hits; once your own HP-stacking items come online the long trades start flipping back your way, except during Yorick's R (Eulogy of the Isles) windows where the Maiden adds bonus auto damage and more walkers.

tell.watch: Yorick's Maiden of the Mist uptime

theirWindow.when: while his Maiden of the Mist is active
theirWindow.what: Attacks he lands against your target get bonus damage through the Maiden, and she raises more Mist Walkers from anyone who dies nearby — do not commit to an extended trade or all-in while she's up.

yourWindow.when: once the Maiden despawns or his R is down
yourWindow.what: Without the Maiden's bonus damage and walker generation, Yorick's damage output drops hard — this is when you pop E (Masochism) off your missing health and commit to the all-in.

start.why: Runs 53.5% winrate over 127 games (76.1% pick) and its sustain directly answers the constant poke from Yorick's E (Mourning Mist) and grave-digging Q autos.

boots.why: Higher winrate pick (54.9% over 91 games, 58.7% pick) and the extra movement speed matters against a kit built to wall you in and swarm you with Mist Walkers.

core.why: Part of the highest-winrate path (64.7% over 17 games); the massive HP pool multiplies your passive Adrenaline Rush regen each second.
Stacks more max health on top of Warmog's, which directly inflates the damage your own Q deals to targets later while giving you the HP buffer to tank his horde.
Converts your bloated HP pool into AD and adds an AoE swing, useful for clearing Mist Walkers that stack up around Yorick.

his Last Rites self-heal keeps winning extended trades and you need to cut it down
you're getting poked down early and need cheap grievous wounds plus armor against his Q autos

runes.keystoneWhy: Every proc heals and stacks bonus max health, which both out-sustains Yorick's E mark chip and feeds your own Q since it scales off max health.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best winrate of the three recorded pairings (57.4% over 37.4% pick) — Flash gets you out of a Dark Procession wall trap, Teleport resets you to lane after losing the early poke war.

playing.title: Punish grave-digging autos
playing.detail: Yorick's Q (Last Rites, cooldown 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s) only grants its bonus damage and heal on his next attack — poke with your Q (Infected Cleaver, cooldown 4s, range 975) at max range right before he's due to land one so he doesn't get the free value.

playing.title: Save E for the all-in
playing.detail: E (Masochism, cooldown 7s) scales your bonus AD off missing health, so hold it until you're already well below half health rather than popping it on a safe poke trade.

playing.title: Burn W on grouped walkers
playing.detail: W (Burning Agony, cooldown 1s, range 325) drains your own health but hits everyone nearby continually — use it when Mist Walkers are swarming you so the damage spreads across the whole horde, not just Yorick.

playing.title: Break the wall, don't dodge it
playing.detail: If W (Dark Procession) traps you with him, attack the wall itself since it's destructible — standing inside tanking autos just lets his E mark and Last Rites heal snowball.

playing.title: Time your R around his Maiden
playing.detail: His R (Eulogy of the Isles, cooldown 160/130/100/100/100s) summons a Maiden that boosts his auto damage and raises more walkers from kills — pop your own R (Sadism, cooldown 75s) to disengage and regen until the Maiden is gone before re-committing.

playing.title: Poke before his HP inflates
playing.detail: Your Q damage is based on his max health, so land it early and often — if he builds into a bigger HP pool it only makes each Q hit harder, so don't let him sit uncontested at range 975.

playing.title: Prioritize boots if he walls every trade
playing.detail: If he's consistently using W to box you in, finish Boots of Swiftness before your second item so you can close distance or disengage before the wall fully forms.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, boots, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from current-patch OP.GG games (17,063 Mundo top games overall, 135 in this matchup); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.
